flows_requiring_real_funds_to_progress_f: Shield SOL - needs actual SOL in the NullCash Wallet deposit address before quote can be signed/settled (UI correctly stops at amount input / insufficient balance).
In-pool Swap tab - needs SOL in wallet before Jupiter quote via /api/bifrost/v1/relayer can be executed.
Send / Private pay - needs private balance >0 (CTA 'Your private balance is empty').
Bridge - needs source balance to progress past 'Type an amount'.

Private route (HoudiniSwap SOL->ETH) - the UI reaches 'Review swap' and 'Order created' modal with Solana deposit address (independently reproduced in iter21 & iter22 live); no funds move until user actually sends SOL to the deposit address.
Privacy swap (NEAR Intents SOL->USDC Ethereum) - same: order can be created with deposit address, but settlement needs real deposit.
All of the above are EXPECTED behaviour for a fresh unfunded vault, NOT bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: The 'Create a NullCash vault' card inside the connect sheet has no data-testid. Only its parent class (.wopt.wopt-own) is reachable - consider adding data-testid='nc-connect-create-vault' on that <button> and data-testid='nc-vault-password-1'/'nc-vault-password-2' on the two password inputs plus data-testid='nc-vault-create-submit' on the Create button and data-testid='nc-vault-recovery-key' on the recovery key container + data-testid='nc-vault-open' on the final 'Open NullCash' CTA. Would eliminate the DOM-walk JS that current tests have to use.

The Private route destination token picker rows (ETH / Ethereum · Ethereum, etc.) don't expose a stable data-testid like 'dk-pick-ETH-ethereum' - selectors have to use text content which is brittle when prices or dollar amounts are concatenated. Nice-to-have for future automation.
